harrat-mujtaba:1-1.t: «إذا»: a pure adverb attached to (mutaʿalliq) the implied أقسم (I swear).

harrat-mujtaba:3-3.t: «ما» applies to individual rational beings, and it is a relative noun conjoined to «النهار».

harrat-mujtaba:4-4.t: (إن سعيكم لشتى) [Translator's note: phrase discussed] The answer to the oath (jawāb al-qasam).

harrat-mujtaba:5-5.t: The fāʾ is a conjunction; «أما»: a particle of condition and detailing; «من»: a relative noun, mubtadaʾ (subject), whose khabar (predicate) is the clause {فَسَنُيَسِّرُهُ}, and the fāʾ is the linking one; the clause is conjoined to the clause {إِنَّ سَعْيَكُمْ لَشَتَّى}.

harrat-mujtaba:7-7.t: (فسنيسره لليسرى) [Translator's note: phrase discussed] The fāʾ is the linking one.

harrat-mujtaba:8-8.t: The conditional clause is conjoined to the preceding conditional clause; «من»: a relative noun, mubtadaʾ (subject).

harrat-mujtaba:10-10.t: The clause «فسنيسره» is the khabar (predicate) of the relative «من».

harrat-mujtaba:11-11.t: The clause «وما يغني» is conjoined to the clause «سنيسره»; «إذا»: adverbial and conditional, attached to (mutaʿalliq) the implied apodosis; its apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) is omitted, indicated by what precedes it, its implied form being: "his wealth will not avail him".

harrat-mujtaba:12-12.t: (إن علينا للهدى) [Translator's note: phrase discussed] The lām is for emphasis.

harrat-mujtaba:14-14.t: The clause «فأنذرتكم» is conjoined to the clause {إِنَّ عَلَيْنَا لَلْهُدَى}; «نارا»: second object; and the clause «تلظى» is a naʿt (adjective) of «نارا».

harrat-mujtaba:15-15.t: The clause «لا يصلاها» is a second naʿt (adjective) of {نَارًا}.

harrat-mujtaba:16-16.t: (الذي كذب وتولى) [Translator's note: phrase discussed] The relative noun is a naʿt (adjective) of {الأَشْقَى}.

harrat-mujtaba:17-17.t: The clause «وسيجنبها» is conjoined to the clause {لا يَصْلاهَا}.

harrat-mujtaba:18-18.t: The clause «يتزكى» is a ḥāl (circumstantial) from the fāʿil (agent) of «يؤتي».

harrat-mujtaba:19-19.t: The clause «وما لأحد عنده من نعمة» is a ḥāl (circumstantial) from the fāʿil (agent) of {يَتَزَكَّى}; the preposition «لأحد» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) the khabar (predicate) of the mubtadaʾ (subject) «نعمة», and «من» is redundant (zāʾida); «عنده»: an adverb of place attached to a ḥāl from «نعمة»; and the clause «تجزى» is a naʿt (adjective) of نعمة.

harrat-mujtaba:20-20.t: «إلا» is for restriction (ḥaṣr); «ابتغاء» is mafʿūl li-ajlihi (object of purpose).

harrat-mujtaba:21-21.t: The clause «ولسوف يرضى» is the answer to an implied oath (jawāb qasam muqaddar), and the implied oath clause is resumptive.
